facts.fact: 事后如释重负：积压几周的躁动被烧空；一个月前和那个女人毫无感觉，这次完全相反。
facts.anchor: The relief is so strong it almost makes my knees weak. Every ounce of restless frustration that’s been sitting under my skin for weeks feels burned out of me. My head is clearer and my body feels loose and satisfied in a way it hasn’t in a long time. A month ago, with that woman, I felt nothing. This? This was the complete opposite.

facts.fact: 他自认阴暗地庆幸 Kit 没说 no，已在想下一次——纯生理、别无其他（他的说辞）。
facts.anchor: I know he was too scared to actually say no; the chance was there and he didn’t take it. A small, dark part of me is selfishly glad. Because his body… fuck. That tight little hole, the way he clenched around me when he came, those broken moans he tried so hard to hide; I’m already thinking about doing it again. Purely physical, nothing else, just that perfect, responsive body.

facts.fact: 自己的皮带还捆着 Kit 的手腕——他在自我陶醉里完全忘了解开。
facts.anchor: I never took it off, totally forgot in my own bliss.

facts.fact: 解开后见腕上淡红勒痕，胸口一阵说不清的难受，又一次强迫自己「我不在乎」。
facts.anchor: Faint reddish marks circle both wrists where the leather sat too tightly. Something uncomfortable twists in my chest at the sight… I don’t know why I care, yet again, I have to tell myself that I don’t.

facts.fact: 临别俯身耳语：替我把这具小身体洗干净，Christopher，你不知道我下次什么时候来。
facts.anchor: Keep this tight little body clean for me, Christopher. You never know when I’ll come for you next.

facts.fact: Kit 瞪眼与他对视整整两秒、脸更红、使劲吞咽后轻轻点头；Soren 满足地夸 Good boy。
facts.anchor: His eyes meet mine, wide and stunned, for two full seconds. The blush on his face deepens. He swallows hard and gives a single, tiny nod.

facts.fact: 对 Ray 一句顶回去：他听话，感觉很好，没有感情——我不玩那套。
facts.anchor: Don’t be stupid, Ray. He obeys, and it felt good. No emotions; I don’t do that shit.

facts.fact: Ray 转述：处理掉 Everlys 之后其余成员要么散伙要么深藏，本地分支基本完蛋。
facts.anchor: He thinks after you dealt with the Everlys, the rest of the cell either scattered or went deep into hiding. Ruez and his men are leaning toward the idea that the local branch is pretty much finished. Whatever’s left of Zero Hour has probably moved operations somewhere else entirely.

facts.fact: Soren 心里不买账：Finished 是个干净好听的话，但这种人不配「干净」二字。
facts.anchor: “Finished” is a nice word, clean. But I don’t trust clean when it comes to people like that.

facts.fact: 核心反转：他禁止任何人打扰 Kit，不许他知道父母给 Zero Hour 递情报、造武器，就让他认定 Soren 是杀亲仇人。
facts.anchor: He doesn’t need to know they were wrapped up with Zero Hour, feeding them information and building them weapons. Let him keep thinking they were just his innocent mom and dad and that I’m the bad man that killed them.

facts.fact: 一句 He’s safer that way 带过动机。
Ray 点破：你从不养闲人、不保护人——Christopher 凭什么在你 Sinclair 手里得到特殊待遇？
facts.anchor: You don’t take people captive to just live in your home. You don’t protect people like him. I’m just wondering why Christopher is getting special treatment from you, Mr. Sinclair of all people.

facts.fact: 章末自问：我他妈为什么这么在意让他活着、关在屋里、受着保护？
facts.anchor: Why the fuck am I this bothered about keeping Kit alive? About keeping him indoors, out of sight, and protected?
